That lifts node X to about 1.5 V and gives M2 a Vds of about 0.5 V. Long-L PMOS mirrors (λ≈0.005/V) keep line regulation at a few mV/V. Current budget is 3×4 uA + 1.5 uA follower + 0.4 uA start-up, about 25 uW. K·UT·ln8 ≈ 0.53 V cancels the Veb slope."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "I":      (4e-6, 1e-6, 10e-6),     # per-branch PTAT current
    "K":      (9.8, 8.0, 12.0),        # R2/R1
    "gmid_p": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),       # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "Lp":     (8.0, 2.0, 16.0),        # long L for low lambda -> line regulation
    "gmid_n": (18.0, 10.0, 22.0),      # NMOS level-shift pair (weak inversion, low Vgs)
    "Ln":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "If":     (1.5e-6, 0.5e-6, 5e-6),  # follower bias current
    "Cc":     (1e-12, 0.2e-12, 5e-12), # X-node compensation / supply-tracking cap to vdd
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 8
    I = p["I"]; K = p["K"]
    R1 = UT * math.log(N) / I
    R2 = K * R1

    # Branch nodes: Veb estimates (m=1 PNP: 0.76 V @10 uA)
    veb1 = 0.76 + UT * math.log(I / 10e-6)
    # PMOS mirror (M3, M4, M5 identical)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.4)
    vg = VDD - mp.vgs                         # PMOS gate node
    # NMOS level-shift pair, sources at ~veb1 (equal vsb by construction)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.5, vsb=veb1)
    vgn = veb1 + mn.vgs
    # NMOS source follower: gate X, source vg, Rf to vss
    mf = lut.size("n", 18.0, 1.0, p["If"], vds=VDD - vg, vsb=vg)
    Rf = vg / p["If"]
    vx = vg + mf.vgs

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PMOS mirror
    n.dev("M3", "ngate", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)   # feeds NMOS diode branch
    n.dev("M4", "x", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)       # feeds high-impedance node X
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "vg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)    # output branch
    # NMOS level-shift pair
    n.dev("M1", "ngate", "ngate", "ea", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "ngate", "sb", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "sb", "eb", R1)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "ea", m=1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "eb", m=N)
    # Output: Vref = Veb3 + I*R2
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    # Follower drives PMOS gates (headroom fix)
    n.dev("MF", "vdd", "x", "vg", "vss", mf)
    n.R("RF", "vg", "vss", Rf)
    n.C("CC", "x", "vdd", p["Cc"])
    # Start-up: when vref low, st high -> MS1 pulls vg low
    n.M("MSP", "st", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSN", "st", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS1", "vg", "st", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 2.0, 0.5)

    # Predictions
    ptat = K * UT * math.log(N)
    vref = veb1 + ptat
    dveb = (veb1 - 1.2) / 300.0 - 0.25e-3
    dptat = ptat / 300.15
    resid = abs(dveb + dptat)
    curv = 2.5e-3                                  # residual curvature bow (V)
    tc = (resid * 165 + curv) / vref / 165 * 1e6
    lam = mp.gds / mp.Id
    line = ptat * lam * (1 + 1 / math.log(N)) * 1e3   # mV/V
    itot = 3 * I + p["If"] + 0.4e-6
    power = VDD * itot
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line, "power": power,
               "startup_ok": 1, "psrr_1k": -db(line * 1e-3 + 1e-4),
               "vx": vx, "vg": vg, "vgn": vgn, "m2_vds": vx - veb1}
```
